reference_sql:
SELECT a.spend_date, a.campaign_id, a.spend,
  SUM(a.spend) OVER (ORDER BY a.spend_date, a.campaign_id ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_spend_eur
FROM ad_spend_daily a
JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
WHERE c.channel_id = 2
  AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
alternatives:
WITH rows_in AS (
  -- one row per campaign and day with spend
  SELECT a.spend_date, a.campaign_id, a.spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE c.channel_id = 2
    AND a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
)
SELECT r.spend_date, r.campaign_id, r.spend,
  (SELECT SUM(r2.spend) FROM rows_in r2
   WHERE r2.spend_date < r.spend_date OR (r2.spend_date = r.spend_date AND r2.campaign_id <= r.campaign_id)) AS running_spend_eur
FROM rows_in r
